pictures.name: full_basket_left_at_a_door
pictures.scene: a woven basket heaped with bread and fruit set down and left at an open doorway, the basket lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the doorway and wall above it dim and plain and quiet

pictures.name: measuring_rod_laid_on_timber
pictures.scene: a straight measuring rod lying along a squared beam of pale timber on a workbench, the rod and the beam lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the workshop above them brown and dim and still

pictures.name: worn_detour_grown_over_with_grass
pictures.scene: a track where an old wandering loop to one side has grown over with grass while the straight way stays clear, the near path lit warm and gold low in the frame, the country above it pale and open

pictures.name: orchard_watered_and_thriving
pictures.scene: an orchard with water running in channels between the rows and every tree in strong leaf, the nearest channel lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the green canopy above it soft and dim

pictures.name: mud_thrown_on_a_white_wall
pictures.scene: splashes of dark mud flung across a clean whitewashed wall, the lowest splashes lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the pale wall rising above them bright and plain and otherwise unmarked

pictures.name: hard_stone_beside_soft_earth
pictures.scene: a lump of hard grey stone lying next to a patch of dark crumbling soil with a shoot in it, both lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the ground and light above them soft and dim and quiet

pictures.name: vine_cut_back_and_budding
pictures.scene: a vine pruned hard back to bare stubs with small bright new buds already swelling on it, the cut wood lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the trellis above it dim and open and empty

pictures.name: small_jewel_outweighing_a_heap_of_coins
pictures.scene: a balance holding one small bright gem in the low pan and a heap of coins lifted high in the other, the gem and its pan lit warm and brilliant low in the frame, the wall above them dim and plain

pictures.name: heaped_silver_left_in_the_shade
pictures.scene: a great heap of dull silver pieces poured out on a floor and left in deep shade, the nearest coins lit faintly cool at the bottom of the frame, the room above and behind them dark and still and cold

lines.text: You are good to Your servant, O LORD,
Teach me good judgment and knowledge,
for I believe in Your commandments.
Before I was afflicted, I went astray;
but now I keep Your word.
You are good, and You do what is good;
Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies,
I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
Their hearts are callous and insensitive,
but I delight in Your law.
It was good for me to be afflicted,
that I might learn Your statutes.
The law from Your mouth is more precious to me
than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
